admin.jobs.attempts.description: Term in a job's details: how many times the job ran.

admin.jobs.created_at.description: Term in a job's details: when the job was enqueued first.

admin.jobs.empty.description: Heading of the job list when no job is in the selected state.

admin.jobs.empty.dead.description: Heading of the job list of failed jobs when no job failed for good.

admin.jobs.failed_at.description: Term in a failed job's details: when the job failed for good.

admin.jobs.filter.count.description: Accessible text of the count beside a tab of the job list, read right after the tab's name (so it starts with a comma): how many jobs the tab lists.

admin.jobs.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tabs that filter the jobs by state.

admin.jobs.filter.pending.description: Tab of the jobs screen with the jobs not done yet: waiting, running and retrying.

admin.jobs.history.attempt.description: Heading of one record of a job's attempt history. {number} is the number of the run, from 1, formatted; {outcome} is admin.jobs.outcome.retry or admin.jobs.outcome.dead.

admin.jobs.history.empty.description: Heading of a job's attempt history when no failed run is recorded.

admin.jobs.history.empty.description.defaultMessage: Runs that succeed are not recorded, and the records are deleted after a while.
admin.jobs.history.empty.description.description: Description of an empty attempt history: why a job may have no records.

admin.jobs.history.error.description: Term in a record of a job's attempt: why the run failed.

admin.jobs.history.failed.description: Heading in place of a job's attempt history when it failed to load.

admin.jobs.history.finished_at.description: Term in a record of a job's attempt: when the run ended.

admin.jobs.history.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the records of a job's attempts load.

admin.jobs.history.more_failed.description: Message under a job's attempt history when its next page failed to load.

admin.jobs.history.retry.description: Button that loads a job's attempt history again after it failed to load.

admin.jobs.history.started_at.description: Term in a record of a job's attempt: when the run started.

admin.jobs.history.toggle.description: Button of a job that shows or hides the records of its runs that failed.

admin.jobs.history.toggle_job.description: Accessible name of the attempt history button of a job, which names the job. {type} is the job type.

admin.jobs.idempotency_key.description: Term in a job's details: the key that keeps the job from being enqueued twice.

admin.jobs.last_error.description: Term in a job's details: why the job's last run failed.

admin.jobs.list.heading.description: Heading of the region of the jobs screen with the list of jobs.

admin.jobs.locked_until.description: Term in a running job's details: when the worker's hold on it ends, after which another worker may run it.

admin.jobs.ordering_key.description: Term in a job's details: the key that runs the jobs with the same key one after another.

admin.jobs.outcome.dead.description: Outcome of the failed run that made a job fail for good, in the heading of its record.

admin.jobs.outcome.retry.description: Outcome of a failed run of a job that runs again, in the heading of its record.

admin.jobs.payload.description: Term in a job's details: the job's input data, as JSON.

admin.jobs.queue.adapter.description: Term in the queue's details: the kind of job queue the server runs, such as db or sqs.

admin.jobs.queue.by_state.description: Accessible name of the tiles of the jobs screen: the longest wait and the count of the jobs of each state.

admin.jobs.queue.by_type.description: Accessible name of the list of the counts of the jobs of each job type.

admin.jobs.queue.heading.description: Heading of the region of the jobs screen with the counts of the jobs of the queue.

admin.jobs.queue.no_listing.defaultMessage: This queue cannot list its waiting, running and retrying jobs: see their backlog in the metrics of the platform. Failed jobs and the history of their attempts are listed.
admin.jobs.queue.no_listing.description: Note of the queue region when the queue (Cloud Tasks or SQS) cannot list its pending jobs.

admin.jobs.retried.defaultMessage: The job {type} is queued to run again.
admin.jobs.retried.description: Announcement after an operator ran a failed job again. {type} is the job type, such as federation.deliver.

admin.jobs.run_again.description: Button of a failed job that runs it again.

admin.jobs.retry_failed.defaultMessage: Could not run the job again: {reason}
admin.jobs.retry_failed.description: Error toast when a failed job could not be run again. {reason} is the server's localized reason.

admin.jobs.retry_job.description: Accessible name of the run-again button of a failed job, which names the job. {type} is the job type; {date} is when it failed, formatted.

admin.jobs.run_at.description: Term in a job's details: when a pending job is due to run.

admin.jobs.state.description: Term in a job's details: its state, such as waiting or failed.

admin.jobs.state.dead.description: State of a job that failed for good; also a tab and a count.

admin.jobs.state.queued.description: State of a job that has not run yet; also a tab and a count.

admin.jobs.state.retrying.description: State of a job that ran, failed, and waits to run again; also a tab and a count.

admin.jobs.state.running.description: State of a job that a worker runs now; also a tab and a count.

admin.jobs.summary.defaultMessage: Background jobs waiting, running, retrying and failed, why they failed, and running failed ones again.
admin.jobs.summary.description: Description of the jobs screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.jobs.title.description: Heading of the admin screen of the background job queue (waiting, running, retrying and failed jobs), and its link in the administration menu.

admin.jobs.unlisted.defaultMessage: This queue cannot list these jobs
admin.jobs.unlisted.description: Heading in place of the list of pending jobs when the queue (Cloud Tasks or SQS) cannot list them.

admin.jobs.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: See the backlog in the metrics of the platform. Failed jobs are listed under Failed.
admin.jobs.unlisted.description.description: Description in place of the list of pending jobs when the queue cannot list them.

admin.jobs.worker.description: Term in a job's or an attempt's details: the name of the worker that runs or ran it.
